div.head: Hn com 3
div.ab: Et si amodo exurgat placitum de divisione terrarum vel de preocupatione, si est inter barones meos dominicos, tractetur placitum in curia mea.
And if henceforth a case arises concerning the division or occupation of lands—if it is between crown barons of mine, the case shall be dealt with in my court.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 286–287 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added
